output.question: What is Apple's annual revenue?
output.answer: Apple Inc.’s latest annual revenue was US$478.834 billion for fiscal 2026, ended September 26, 2026. Revenue, reported as total net sales, increased 15% from US$416.161 billion in fiscal 2025. ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/320193/000032019326000026/aapl-20260926.htm))

key_facts.fact: Apple reported total net sales of US$478.834 billion for fiscal 2026, ended September 26, 2026.
Fiscal 2026 total net sales increased 15% from US$416.161 billion in fiscal 2025, ended September 27, 2025.
